feedback.problem: A particle $P$ moves along the $x$-axis and its velocity at time $t$ is given by $v(t)={t}^{2}-7t+10.$ What is the total displacement of the particle between $t=2$ and $t=5?$
feedback.worked_solution:
We find the total displacement by calculating the definite integral of the velocity.

Let $d$ be the total displacement. Then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}d & ={\int }_{2}^{5}({t}^{2}-7t+10)\,\text{d}t \\  & ={(\frac{1}{3}{t}^{3}-\frac{7}{2}{t}^{2}+10t)|}_{2}^{5} \\  & =[\frac{1}{3}(5)^{3}-\frac{7}{2}(5)^{2}+10(5)]-[\frac{1}{3}(2)^{3}-\frac{7}{2}(2)^{2}+10(2)] \\  & =[\frac{125}{3}-\frac{175}{2}+50]-[\frac{8}{3}-14+20] \\  & =\frac{25}{6}-\frac{26}{3} \\  & =-\frac{9}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

 

So the total displacement between $t=2$ and $t=5$ is $-\frac{9}{2}.$
